messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: You should not use losartan if you are allergic to losartan.
If you have diabetes, do not take losartan with any medication that contains aliskiren.
Aliskiren is a blood pressure medicine.
To make sure losartan is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have ever had:
heart disease or congestive heart failure;
an electrolyte imbalance (such as high levels of potassium in your blood);
if you are on a low-salt diet;
liver disease; or
kidney disease.
You may also need to avoid taking losartan with aliskiren if you have kidney disease.
Stop using losartan and tell your doctor right away if you become pregnant.
Losartan can cause injury or death to the unborn baby.
You should not breastfeed while using losartan and for 2 days after your last dose.

The relation 'contraindicated with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug should not be used in combination with the substance or medication specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
B. 'not administered via': The subject drug should not be given using the route or method specified by the object entity.
C. 'not used for': The subject drug is not indicated or used for the condition, situation, or purpose specified by the object entity.
D. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
E. 'not chemically related to': The subject drug is not chemically similar to or related to the substance specified by the object entity.
